stateResearchStatus: Election review 29 October: December extraordinary postal polls close on 3 December at 6 pm Perth (AWST). Esperance Town Ward has a vacancy following Cr Johnston’s August resignation. At Bridgetown-Greenbushes, official records differ on whether Simon Robinson's resignation took effect on 6 or 9 October. The special meeting agenda says an extraordinary election is required and records WA Electoral Commissioner approval for 18 March 2027 as the date to be fixed. The final decision, method and timetable remain unverified. State Parliament composition retains its earlier review; individual council results and federal rosters are not freshly certified. Gingin: Jason Weeks resigned effective 3 November; the replacement process and election date are unconfirmed. Carnarvon’s Shire publishes nominees for President (3), Town Ward (10 for 4 seats) and Gascoyne/Minilya Ward (2). It identifies Mark Young (Coral Bay, term expiry 2029) and Paul Shain (Plantation, term expiry 2027) as elected unopposed. The Commissioner continues until the new council first meets. Checked 14 November.
